{{Youmay|the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] program|the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: A Galaxy Divided|DVD release]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series}}
'''''A Galaxy Divided''''' was a [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] program detailing and investigating current events in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] around the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
The show featured news updates relating to the ongoing events of the war, including panel debates with experts.
